> console op Bot
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Bot joined the game
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Made Bot a server operator
> console whitelist add Bot
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Added Bot to the whitelist
> console ban-ip 5.6.7.8 spam
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Banned IP 5.6.7.8: spam
> console pardon-ip 5.6.7.8
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Unbanned IP 5.6.7.8
> console ban-ip 6.7.8.9 other
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Banned IP 6.7.8.9: other
> console ban Bot a reason
  log: [Server thread/INFO] Bot lost connection: <reason>
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Banned Bot: a reason
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Bot left the game
> console save-all flush
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Saved the game
  log: [Server thread/INFO] System chat: Saving the game (this may take a moment!)
